text: DBIM PERSONAS DRAW EVERY APPLICANT GROUP. Each of the eleven Explore User Personas slides now carries its drawing from the MoSJE Handoff file's Persona Illustrations (Type of Applicant) — rendered from the handoff frame at 2× (320 px, transparent) and palette-compressed to 21–37 KB, inside DBIM 3.0's 100 KB thumbnail limit. The interim of earlier the same day (Toolkit drawings for Students and Senior Citizens, icons for the other nine) is gone, and with it the carousel's icon fallback. The drawings are to be revised later if required.
